minimum.note: Roblox states a minimum of 30,000 Earned Robux to submit a DevEx request. Meeting the number is not the same as being approved.

rates.label: Standard rate
rates.eligibilitySummary: The standard DevEx rate applied to eligible Earned Robux. Roblox documents this as {rateStandard} USD per Earned Robux, which is {payout30000Plain} USD for {minimumRobux} Earned Robux.

rates.label: Eligible U.S. 18+ rate
rates.eligibilitySummary: A higher rate Roblox applies to certain Earned Robux from purchases of developer products, passes, subscriptions, and private servers made by United States players who have verified that they are at least 18 years old.
rates.conditionNote: This rate is not selectable by the creator. Roblox determines which portion of a balance qualifies. Do not assume a whole balance earns this rate.

rates.label: Legacy balance rate
rates.eligibilitySummary: The rate that applied before 5 September 2025 at 10:00 PT, equal to {payoutLegacy30000Plain} USD for {minimumRobux} Earned Robux. Roblox cashes out balances earned before that moment at this older rate first.
rates.conditionNote: Applies only to the portion of a balance earned before the transition, under Roblox's own accounting. A creator cannot choose this rate.

schemes.label: In-experience purchase
schemes.description: Developer products, passes, private servers and subscriptions bought inside an experience you own.

schemes.label: Marketplace avatar item sale
schemes.description: An avatar item sold through the Roblox Marketplace. The creator share rises with the item's price as a multiple of the price floor.

schemes.label: Avatar item sold inside an experience
schemes.description: An avatar item bought inside an experience. The item creator and the experience owner are paid separately.

limits.note: These are application safety limits chosen by DevExCalculator.org to keep arithmetic and rendering bounded. They are not Roblox limits and must never be presented as such.
